bodyHtml:
Welcoming 2026: Happy New Year and the Year of the Horse| AQUASKY

As we step into 2026, the Year of the Horse, AQUASKY sends our warmest wishes to partners, customers, and friends around the world. The New Year is a time of renewal, hope, and bold new beginnings - and the spirit of the Horse perfectly captures the energy we bring into the year ahead.

In traditional culture, the Horse symbolizes strength, freedom, speed, and perseverance. It represents moving forward with confidence, breaking boundaries, and chasing goals with passion. These values align deeply with AQUASKY’s vision: to keep innovating, moving faster, and delivering reliable, high-quality solutions that help our customers go further.

Looking back, we are grateful for the trust and support you have shown us. Every collaboration and every shared success have helped shape AQUASKY into what we are today. Looking ahead to 2026, we are excited to continue improving our products and services, strengthening partnerships, and exploring new opportunities together.

May the Year of the Horse bring you:

• Energy to pursue new goals,

• Courage to embrace change,

• Prosperity in your business and personal life, and

• Happiness and health for you and your loved ones.

From all of us at AQUASKY, we wish you a joyful, successful, and inspiring New Year. Let’s ride into 2026 with confidence and create a brighter future together.

Happy New Year 2026! ????✨

 

Holiday Notice: Aquasky’s Lunar New Year Schedule for 2026

Please note that our offices take a short holiday break from February 14th to February 22th, 2026, to celebrate the Lunar New Year. During this period, our offices and operations will be temporarily closed, and responses to inquiries and order processing may be slower than usual. We will resume our operations on February 23th, 2026.

We kindly encourage our partners and customers to plan ahead. For urgent matters, please contact our Sales in advance. We appreciate your understanding and continued support.
